For our client in Kessel, we are looking for a production employee for the Maintenance and Laundry department. In this role, you’ll be responsible for inspecting used materials for quality, cleaning them, packaging, and getting them ready for transport or storage. You'll work with modern machinery to ensure the customer receives rental items that are complete, clean, and undamaged. You’ll be handling various tent components such as floors, walls, doors, windows, and canvases, cleaning them both manually and with machines. Familiarity with industrial machinery and using a high-pressure cleaner is essential.Your tasks will include:- Washing and maintaining tent components and rental materials (e.g., floors, walls, doors, windows, and canvases) by machine and hand;- Operating industrial washers, dryers, high-pressure cleaners, and overhead cranes;- Monitoring product quality and detecting any damages;- Inspecting and packing canvases;- Preparing materials for storage or transport;- Maintaining a safe and sustainable workspace.You will be working in an international environment where Dutch and English are the primary languages. Working hours are from 07:00 to 15:30, Monday through Friday.We are seeking someone with experience in an industrial production setting and a hands-on approach. You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and tackle physical tasks. Additionally, you possess:- A completed VMBO or basic vocational education (level 2) or an equivalent qualification;- Good command of Dutch or English;- A forklift certification, or you’re willing to obtain one;- A desire to grow by participating in internal training opportunities.

Over het werk As a production operator, you will be responsible for ensuring that all materials required for the process are ready for use and that the production process runs smoothly. You will also test the finished product according to work instructions and specifications. It is essential that all activities are carried out in a safe working environment. If unsafe situations arise, you are responsible for stopping the work. In this role, you will be responsible for carrying out standard operating and/or assembly and disassembly activities, both manually and with the help of control panels. You will report any irregularities to the Machine Operator or (Assistant) Shift Supervisor. In the event of equipment malfunctions, depending on the level of difficulty, you will either attempt to resolve the issue yourself or call in the Technical Service Department. You will therefore perform first-line maintenance on the machines. If you are unable to resolve an issue, you will ask your supervisor for assistance.
